invite.name: Person's name
invite.accessTitle: Give {{name}} access to the shared folder
invite.accessIntro: This is not done in Open ClubManager but at your provider.
invite.accessDone: Done – {{name}} has access to the folder

Nextcloud: Open Nextcloud in the browser and log in.
Click the share icon next to the folder.
Enter the Nextcloud user name or e-mail address of {{name}}.
Allow “Edit”. Without write access Open ClubManager cannot synchronize.
OneDrive: Right-click the club's folder and choose “Share”.
Enter the e-mail address of {{name}} and choose “Can edit”.
{{name}} then has to “Add to My files” so the folder arrives on the computer.
Dropbox: Enter the e-mail address of {{name}} and choose “Can edit”.
Google Drive: Open Google Drive in the browser.
Right-click the club's folder and choose “Share”.
Enter the e-mail address of {{name}} and choose “Editor”.
{{name}} needs “Google Drive for desktop” so the folder arrives on the computer.
other: Share the club's folder with {{name}}, with write access.
For a network drive: make sure {{name}} can reach the drive, also from home.

invite.codeHint: Send {{name}} this code, e.g. by e-mail or messenger. It is valid for 7 days and can be used once.
invite.safetyHint: Important: when {{name}} joins, you will be told a 6-digit safety code – ideally by phone. {{name}} only gets access once you enter it.
invite.mail:
Hello {{name}},

you are now {{role}} at {{club}}. We manage the club with Open ClubManager.

1. Install Open ClubManager.
2. On start, choose “Together with others – I have an invite”.
3. Enter this invite code: {{code}}

I already shared the folder with you. When you are done, I will give you a quick call to compare the safety code.

Best regards
{{sender}}
